sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): carries a single Mount Tabor row naming one member only as 'R. Gasperetti' of 420 Troll Hill Rd, which does not distinguish Robert Gasperetti from R. Matthew Gasperetti III (both are Mount Tabor justices of the peace); no holder is recorded rather than guess

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (selectboard members elected for staggered three-year terms); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Noel Weeks as Mount Tabor's town clerk (townclerk@mounttaborvt.gov)

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names William Basso II as Mount Tabor's town clerk; the June 2026 clerk contact spreadsheet is the later source and governs

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names William Basso II as Mount Tabor's town treasurer; he is superseded as town clerk by the June 2026 clerk contact spreadsheet, which carries no Mount Tabor treasurer entry, so no current treasurer is verified and the post is created without a membership
